title: Microsoft and Intel sign long-term deal for Xeon supply and EMIB packaging

sources.quote: Microsoft is the first company to announce use of Intel Foundry’s EMIB™ (Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge) advanced packaging technology for Azure first-party silicon.

explain: Microsoft and Intel announced a long-term agreement under which Microsoft secures multi-year supply of Intel Xeon server chips and will use Intel Foundry's EMIB packaging for its own Azure chips. No dollar amount was disclosed.
